claim_boundary: This is a deterministic synthetic benchmark of orchestration choices. It is not customer ROI, production SLO, external-model cost, or industrial validation.

multi_agent_vs_traditional.interpretation: No quality, task-success, or perturbation-stability gain was measured; the fixed SOP alone does not justify Multi-Agent.

protocol.cost_boundary: All paths use local deterministic reviewers, so actual model calls and monetary model cost are zero. Token units are an input-size proxy, not billing.
protocol.latency_boundary: Wall-clock values are local single-machine observations, not a production SLO or cross-host throughput benchmark.
protocol.latency_method: per-seed sequential and parallel warm-up, then deterministic rotated architecture order for every repeat and perturbation

orchestration.multi_agent: parallel evidence Workers, six advisory role reviews
orchestration.single_agent: one controller executes tools sequentially, one advisory review
orchestration.traditional_pipeline: parallel deterministic DAG, no Agent review
